sources.title: Model Context Protocol Specification
sources.notes: Latest page resolved to protocol revision 2025-11-25. Covers capability negotiation, tools, resources, prompts, authorization, consent, cancellation, errors, and logging.

sources.title: Agent2Agent Protocol Specification
sources.notes: Covers agent discovery, task lifecycle, streaming, idempotency, authentication, authorization, artifacts, and interoperability.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry Generative AI Semantic Conventions
sources.notes: Primary reference for portable model and agent telemetry. Stability of individual conventions must be checked before implementation.

sources.title: AI Risk Management Framework
sources.notes: Risk-based governance reference. Use as a control framework, not a substitute for product-specific threat modeling.

sources.title: Generative AI Profile for the AI RMF
sources.notes: Generative-AI-specific risk profile; verify the latest publication and errata during adoption.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Generative AI Applications
sources.notes: Includes prompt injection, sensitive disclosure, supply chain, poisoning, output handling, excessive agency, prompt leakage, vector weaknesses, misinformation, and unbounded consumption.

sources.title: MITRE ATLAS
sources.notes: Adversarial threat knowledge base for AI-enabled systems.

sources.title: SLSA Specification v1.2
sources.notes: Build and source provenance, attestations, and incremental supply-chain assurance.

sources.title: Sigstore
sources.notes: Signing and verification ecosystem candidate. Adoption requires an offline and key-management design.

sources.title: CycloneDX Machine Learning Bill of Materials
sources.notes: Represents models, datasets, configurations, provenance, and risk metadata.

sources.title: SPDX 3.0 Overview
sources.notes: System composition, origin, licensing, AI models, datasets, build information, integrity, and lifecycle metadata.

sources.title: W3C PROV Overview
sources.notes: Interoperable provenance model for entities, activities, agents, derivation, versioning, and reproducibility.

sources.title: Open Policy Agent Documentation
sources.notes: Candidate for decoupled policy decisions. Do not adopt before comparing complexity and embedding cost with the existing policy engine.

sources.title: SPIFFE Overview
sources.notes: Workload identity candidate for distributed deployments; unnecessary for a single-process local baseline.

sources.title: MLPerf Inference Datacenter
sources.notes: Benchmark design and full-system power measurement reference. Product benchmarks must remain workload-specific.

sources.title: Prometheus Overview
sources.notes: Open-source metrics and alerting candidate; metrics are not an exact billing ledger.

sources.title: Grafana Tempo Documentation
sources.notes: Open-source tracing backend candidate compatible with OpenTelemetry.

sources.title: Temporal Documentation
sources.notes: Candidate reference for durable workflows. Adoption is optional and must be compared with a smaller repository-owned executor.

sources.title: WebAssembly System Interface
sources.notes: Candidate capability-oriented sandbox for portable tools; compatibility and cold-start cost require prototypes.

sources.title: gVisor Documentation
sources.notes: Container isolation candidate for Linux deployments; not a universal desktop baseline.

sources.title: Firecracker Documentation
sources.notes: MicroVM isolation candidate for server deployments; operationally heavier than in-process or WASI baselines.

sources.title: OpenSSF Scorecard
sources.notes: Automated open-source project security health signals; scores are evidence inputs, not trust guarantees.

sources.title: OAuth 2.0 Mutual-TLS Client Authentication
sources.notes: Relevant to certificate-bound tokens and mutual authentication in distributed deployments.

sources.title: OAuth 2.0 Step Up Authentication Challenge Protocol
sources.notes: Relevant when high-risk actions require stronger or more recent authentication.

sources.title: Hugging Face Model Cards
sources.notes: Candidate metadata convention for model purpose, limits, datasets, evaluation, and licensing.

sources.title: Ollama Documentation
sources.notes: Current local provider candidate already compatible with the product's OpenAI-style path.

sources.title: llama.cpp Repository
sources.notes: Portable local inference candidate; model license, quantization quality, and hardware fit must be evaluated per model.

sources.title: restic Documentation
sources.notes: Encrypted deduplicated backup candidate; restore drills and key custody remain product responsibilities.

sources.title: actions/checkout v4.2.2 release commit
sources.notes: Reviewed commit pin used by the isolated pilot workflow.

sources.title: actions/setup-node v4.4.0 release commit
sources.notes: Reviewed commit pin used to install the declared Node runtime.

sources.title: actions/upload-artifact v4.6.2 release commit
sources.notes: Reviewed commit pin used only to upload machine-readable CI evidence.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF model card
sources.notes: Official Apache-2.0 GGUF candidate for a small CPU-oriented qualification lane; artifact integrity and actual quality must be measured before use.

sources.title: Node.js Single executable applications
sources.notes: Official Node documentation for platform-specific single-executable packaging; v16 does not claim to have produced a SEA bundle.

sources.title: npm cache documentation
sources.notes: Official documentation for npm content-addressable cache verification; the cache is treated as prepared installation material, not permanent canonical storage.

sources.title: llama.cpp release b9964
sources.notes: Official current release page used to define the isolated model-runtime acquisition lane.

sources.title: Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF
sources.notes: Official model repository; no weight was acquired or packaged in this environment.

sources.title: Playwright browser installation and management
sources.notes: Official guidance for version-specific browser binaries, multi-browser projects, hermetic paths and enterprise-policy limitations.

sources.title: Node.js downloads and signed SHASUM verification
sources.notes: Official distribution source; the current environment runs Node v22.16.0 while newer LTS releases are available.

sources.title: CryptProtectData function
sources.notes: Official Windows DPAPI contract evaluated for a future hash-pinned custody helper.

sources.title: Trusted Platform Module technology overview
sources.notes: Official TPM overview used for target-hardware custody requirements.
